degree_semantics.DECISIVE: Contains evidence necessary or independently sufficient to resolve a material part of the information need within the permitted source world.
degree_semantics.PARTIAL: Materially advances resolution but is insufficient alone and is not merely topical.
degree_semantics.TOPICAL: Same subject/entity but does not materially answer or verify the information need.
degree_semantics.UNKNOWN: Cannot be responsibly determined from permitted context.

unknown_policy: UNKNOWN/unjudged is not equivalent to IRRELEVANT and receives no relevance credit.
